text: Here's where our corner of Louisiana stands as we start the week. Webster Parish has 54 homes on the market with a median price of $250,000 — about $128 a square foot — and well-priced homes are going under contract in right around two weeks, so buyers there need to be ready to move. Claiborne Parish is a different rhythm: 50 homes active, median $240,000 at about $99 a square foot, with homes typically taking a couple of months to find their buyer — that patience can work in a buyer's favor at the negotiating table. In Minden proper, the median sits at $229,450 and homes are moving in about 18 days. Whether you're buying or selling, knowing your parish's pace is half the battle — and I'm always glad to talk through what it means for your street.
